info.title: Post-Upload API
info.description:
One API call to publish videos, photos, text and documents to Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky, Google Business Profile, Discord, Telegram, Slack, Mastodon, WordPress, Dev.to, Hashnode, Lemmy, Nostr, Whop and Listmonk.

**Auth:** `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` (also accepted: `Authorization: Bearer <api key>` or `x-api-key: <key>`). Create keys in the dashboard (Dashboard → API Keys). Endpoints marked with SessionCookie only work from the logged-in dashboard; API keys get 401 there.
**HTTPS only:** plain http:// API calls get 426 HTTPS_REQUIRED (never redirected).
**Rate limits:** 300 requests/min per IP across the API, 30 uploads/min, 10 FFmpeg jobs/min. 429 responses carry `Retry-After` and `RateLimit-*` headers.
**Size:** request bodies up to 100 MB; pass `video_url` for larger videos (server downloads up to 500 MB).
**Timeouts:** requests are cut at 100 s at the edge. Uploads are async by default — poll GET /api/upload/{upload_id}/status or use webhooks.
**Errors:** JSON `{ success: false, error, error_code, …details }` (a few older routes omit `success` or use `code`). Branch on HTTP status + `error_code`.

Docs: https://docs.post-upload.com

post.description:
Publish a video to one or more platforms. Request bodies are limited to 100 MB at the edge. For larger videos (up to 500 MB) send the file with the chunked upload endpoints (/api/upload/chunked/…) and pass `staged_file_id`, or pass a public `video_url` (the server downloads it). Per-platform maxima apply: platforms the file is too large for are skipped (marked failed with FILE_TOO_LARGE_FOR_PLATFORM and listed in `data.skipped_platforms`) and the rest publish; only when no selected platform can take the file is the request refused with 413 FILE_TOO_LARGE_FOR_PLATFORM.

Platform-specific options are plain form fields (see the platform guides). Missing required fields → 400 MISSING_PLATFORM_FIELD; invalid values → 400 INVALID_PLATFORM_OPTION; unknown `<platform>_…` keys → 400 UNKNOWN_PLATFORM_OPTION.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key: a repeat returns the original upload.

user.description: Profile name the post is published from.

platform[].description: Target platforms (repeat the field). `platform` / `platforms` are accepted too.

first_comment.description: Comment posted right after publishing. Per-platform overrides: `<platform>_first_comment`.

schedule.description: ISO-8601 publish time (alias `schedule_at`). Plans without scheduling get 403 SCHEDULING_NOT_AVAILABLE.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for a schedule without an offset.

add_to_queue.description: Publish at the next free queue slot (409 NO_QUEUE_SLOT when none is free).

async_upload.description: true (default): respond immediately, publish in the background. false: wait up to ~50 s for the per-platform result, then answer like an async upload.

request_id.description: Your own tracking id, echoed back and usable with /api/uploadposts/status.

video.description: Video file (≤100 MB through the API edge). Or a public URL string.

video_url.description: Public video URL the server downloads (up to 500 MB).

staged_file_id.description: A file uploaded with the chunked upload endpoints (POST /api/upload/chunked/{upload_session_id}/complete → staged_file_id), instead of `video`. Usable once, by the same user and workspace.

privacy_level.description: TikTok — REQUIRED when posting to TikTok, no default. Must be one of the `privacy_level_options` from GET /api/profiles/{name}/tiktok/creator-info (unaudited apps: SELF_ONLY only). Alias `tiktok_privacy`.

brand_organic_toggle.description: TikTok / Instagram: promoting your own brand.

youtube_playlist_id.description: Add the video to this playlist (alias `playlist_id`).

youtube_thumbnail_url.description: Custom thumbnail (alias `thumbnail_url`), or send a `thumbnail` image file part.

instagram_thumb_offset.description: Instagram Reel cover frame offset in ms (alias `thumb_offset`).

facebook_page_id.description: Facebook Page to post to (list: GET /api/platforms/facebook/pages).

target_linkedin_page_id.description: Post as a LinkedIn company Page (alias `linkedin_page_id`; list: GET /api/platforms/linkedin/pages).

reply_to_id.description: X: numeric Tweet id to reply to.

quote_tweet_id.description: X: accepted for compatibility, but not applied when publishing yet (the post is not a quote tweet).

threads_reply_to_id.description: Threads: numeric post id to reply to.

bluesky_langs.description: Up to 3 BCP-47 codes, comma-separated or repeated `bluesky_langs[]`.

threads_topic_tag.description: Threads topic tag shown on the post (at most 50 characters, without `.` or `&`).

direct_message_deep_link.description: X: https deep link to a direct message conversation (alias `x_direct_message_deep_link`).

instagram_share_to_feed.description: Instagram Reels: also show the Reel in the feed (alias `share_to_feed`).

auto_add_music.description: TikTok photo posts: let TikTok add music.

mastodon_alt_text.description: Mastodon media description (defaults to the title).

wordpress_categories.description: WordPress category ids, comma-separated or an array.

wordpress_tags.description: WordPress tag ids, comma-separated or an array.

devto_tags.description: Dev.to: up to 4 tags, comma-separated (letters and digits only).

devto_canonical_url.description: Dev.to: canonical URL (https) when the article was first published elsewhere.

devto_series.description: Dev.to: series name the article belongs to.

devto_published.description: Dev.to: publish now (default true); false saves a draft.

hashnode_canonical_url.description: Hashnode: original article URL (https) for the canonical link.

lemmy_url.description: Lemmy: link (https) for a link post. With a photo, the link is added to the post body.

lemmy_nsfw.description: Lemmy: mark the post as NSFW.

lemmy_alt_text.description: Lemmy: image alt text (defaults to the title).

listmonk_draft.description: Listmonk: create the campaign as a draft instead of sending it (default false = send to the connected lists).

post.description: For videos over the 100 MB request limit (up to 500 MB). Send the parts with PUT /api/upload/chunked/{upload_session_id}/{index}, then POST …/complete, then POST /api/upload with `staged_file_id`. Videos only (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, MKV). At most 5 sessions in progress per user; sessions expire after 6 hours.

chunk_size.description: Every part is exactly this many bytes, except the last (the remainder).

get.description: Which parts have arrived (`received_chunks`), to resume an interrupted upload.

chunk_size.description: Every part is exactly this many bytes, except the last (the remainder).

put.description: Raw bytes of part `index` (0-based). Exactly `chunk_size` bytes, the last part the remainder. Parts may be sent in any order; re-sending an index replaces it. Max 120 parts per minute.

post.description: Assembles the parts and checks the file is a real video. Returns `staged_file_id` for POST /api/upload (usable once, until `expires_at`). Calling it again returns the same id.

chunk_size.description: Every part is exactly this many bytes, except the last (the remainder).

Forbidden.description: Plan / permission — TIKTOK_PLAN_REQUIRED, UPLOAD_LIMIT_REACHED, SCHEDULING_NOT_AVAILABLE, PROFILE_LOCKED, team role too low.

Conflict.description: Conflict — e.g. NO_QUEUE_SLOT (add_to_queue with no free slot).

PayloadTooLarge.description: FILE_TOO_LARGE_FOR_PLATFORM (`platforms_exceeded[]`; only when no selected platform can take the file) or PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE (over 100 MB at the edge — use the chunked upload or video_url).

TooManyRequests.description: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (300/min), UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT (30/min), FFMPEG_RATE_LIMIT, or PLATFORM_RATE_LIMIT (`exceeded[]`; YouTube includes `resets_at`). Honour `Retry-After`.

BadGateway.description: B2_UPLOAD_FAILED (object storage) or the platform/test endpoint failed. Safe to retry.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Temporarily unavailable (maintenance or dependency down). Retry after `Retry-After`.

PlatformState.description: `deferred`: YouTube daily quota reached — the YouTube part moved to a child upload (its `parent_upload_id` is this upload) scheduled after the quota reset.

skipped_platforms.description: Platforms the file is too large for. They are stored as failed (FILE_TOO_LARGE_FOR_PLATFORM), never sent, and use none of the platform's quota; the other platforms publish.

error_message.description: JSON string `{"platform_errors": {…}}` with the skipped platforms' errors (only when some were skipped).

request_id.description: Your request_id. Returned by GET /api/uploadposts/status only.

parent_upload_id.description: Set on a child upload (e.g. a deferred YouTube part). Returned by GET /api/upload/{upload_id}/status only.

error_message.description: Raw stored error (a JSON string for failed publishes). Kept for compatibility; prefer `error` and `platform_errors`.

error.description: Human-readable error message, e.g. "All 1 platform(s) failed. First error: …". Returned by GET /api/uploadposts/status only.

platform_errors.description: Per-platform failure details, parsed from error_message. Returned by GET /api/uploadposts/status only.

WebhookEvent.description: POSTed to your webhook_url. Header `X-Post-Upload-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, keyed with your webhook secret>`.

profile.description: Only events for this profile; null = every profile
